items.Sentence: The headworks consists of a single static bar screen designed to screen solids.
Water can then be pumped into one of two-5,000 gallon equalization tanks.
Primary treatment is an activated sludge system, which is a package type treatment system. The treatment process is classified as extended aeration.
Secondary treatment consists of a clarifier.
Each coned section is equipped with two airlift pumps – one airlift pump is for return sludge and the other removes scum from the surface.
The disinfection system is a chlorine contact basin which includes sodium hypochlorite storage and chemical feed system.
The treated effluent is conveyed into a 4-acre-foot unlined effluent storage pond.
The solids handling system is composed of three 5,000 gallon aerobic digester tanks and a Draimad sludge bagging system.

The treatment system is composed of flow equalization tanks, an aeration basin, three digesters, a sludge dewatering unit, a secondary clarifier, a chlorine contact basin, a 600,000-gallon storage pond, SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) and controls system.
